questions.stem:
26. The equations of the straight lines \(\ell\) and \(L\) are \(9x+12y-37=0\) and \(12x+16y+85=0\) respectively. \(\ell\) cuts the \(x\)-axis at the point \(A\) while \(L\) cuts the \(y\)-axis at the point \(B\). Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that the perpendicular distance from \(P\) to \(\ell\) is equal to the perpendicular distance from \(P\) to \(L\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\). Which of the following are true?
I. \(\Gamma\) is parallel to \(L\).
II. \(\Gamma\) is perpendicular to \(AB\).
III. \(\Gamma\) passes through the mid-point of \(AB\).
questions.stemZh:
26. \(\ell:9x+12y-37=0\)、\(L:12x+16y+85=0\)。\(\ell\) 與 \(x\) 軸交於 \(A\)，\(L\) 與 \(y\) 軸交於 \(B\)。動點 \(P\) 到兩線等距，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。哪些敘述正確？
I. \(\Gamma\) 平行於 \(L\)。
II. \(\Gamma\) 垂直於 \(AB\)。
III. \(\Gamma\) 經過 \(AB\) 的中點。
questions.solution:
Q90. dse-hkeaa-2023-p2-final-q26
Answer: B
The normalized midline is 3x+4y+107/24=0, parallel to L. A=(37/9,0), B=(0,-85/16); their midpoint lies on it. The slopes -3/4 and -765/592 are not perpendicular. I and III only, B.
questions.solutionZh:
Q90. dse-hkeaa-2023-p2-final-q26
答案: B
正規化後兩線法向量同為 \((3,4)\)，中線為 \(3x+4y+107/24=0\)，故 I 正確。\(A=(37/9,0)\)、\(B=(0,-85/16)\)；中點代入中線等於 \(0\)，故 III 正確。\(\Gamma\) 斜率為 \(-3/4\)，而 \(AB\) 斜率為 \(-765/592\)，兩者不互相垂直，II 錯。

questions.stem:
26. \(A\) and \(B\) are two points on a circle \(C\). Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that it maintains an equal distance from \(A\) and \(B\). Denote the origin and the locus of \(P\) by \(O\) and \(\Gamma\) respectively. Which of the following is/are true?
I. \(\triangle A O B\) is an isosceles triangle.
II. \(\Gamma\) passes through the centre of \(C\).
III. \(\Gamma\) is a parabola passing through the mid-point of \(A B\).
questions.stemZh:
26. \(A\)、\(B\) 為圓 \(C\) 上的兩點。動點 \(P\) 與 \(A\)、\(B\) 等距。以 \(O\) 表示原點，以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(P\) 的軌跡。下列哪些敘述正確？
I. \(\triangle AOB\) 是等腰三角形。
II. \(\Gamma\) 經過圓 \(C\) 的圓心。
III. \(\Gamma\) 是經過 \(AB\) 中點的拋物線。
questions.solution:
Q91. mock-mcs-2324-p2-final-q26
Answer: B
The perpendicular bisector of chord \(AB\) passes through the centre, so II is true. The origin need not be the centre, so \(OA=OB\) is not guaranteed and I need not hold. The locus is a line, not a parabola; III is false.
questions.solutionZh:
Q91. mock-mcs-2324-p2-final-q26
答案: B
\(\Gamma\) 是弦 \(AB\) 的垂直平分線，必經圓心，故 II 正確。原點不一定是圓心，不能推出 \(OA=OB\)，所以 I 不一定正確。軌跡是一條直線，III 錯誤。

questions.stem: 24. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((3,5)\) and \((8,15)\) respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(A P=A B\). Find the equation of the locus of \(P\).
questions.solution:
Q113. mock-sls-2324-p2-final-q24
Answer: C
The fixed point is \(A\), so it is the centre. Since \(AB^2=5^2+10^2=125\), the locus is \((x-3)^2+(y-5)^2=125\), or \(x^2+y^2-6x-10y-91=0\).

questions.stem: 25. The coordinates of the points \(S\) and \(T\) are \((-4,-1)\) and \((-2,3)\) respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(P T=S T\). Find the equation of the locus of \(P\).
questions.solution:
Q114. mock-ywgs-2324-p2-final-q25
Answer: D
The centre is \(T\) and \(ST^2=2^2+4^2=20\). Thus \((x+2)^2+(y-3)^2=20\), or \(x^2+y^2+4x-6y-7=0\). The fixed distance \(PT\) is measured from \(T\).

questions.stem: 26. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((-2,5)\) and \((6,-7)\) respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(P A=P B\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma . U\) and \(V\) are two distinct points on \(\Gamma\) such that \(U A=V B=14\). Find the length of \(U V\).
questions.solution:
Q122. mock-skhtst-2526-p2-final-q26
Answer: B
AM squared=52. Equal distances on the perpendicular bisector give MU=MV=sqrt(196-52)=12. Distinctness puts U,V on opposite sides, so UV=24.
questions.solutionZh:
Q122. mock-skhtst-2526-p2-final-q26
答案: B
設 \(M\) 為 \(AB\) 的中點。\(AM^2=AB^2/4=52\)。因 \(U,V\) 均位於垂直平分線，\(UA=UB=VA=VB=14\)。所以 \(MU=MV=\sqrt{196-52}=12\)。兩點不同，位於 \(M\) 兩側，\(UV=24\)。

questions.stem:
10. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((-4,3)\) and \((6,5)\) respectively. Let \(G\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(A G=B G\). Denote the locus of \(G\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) (i) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(ii) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and the line segment \(A B\).
(b) If \(A B\) is a chord of the circle \(x^{2}+y^{2}-2 a x+4 a y-85=0\), where \(a\) is a constant, find the value of \(a\).
questions.stemZh:
10. 點 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 的坐標分別為 \((-4,3)\) 和 \((6,5)\)。動點 \(G\) 在直角坐標平面上移動，並滿足 \(AG=BG\)。以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(G\) 的軌跡。
(a) (i) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的方程。
(ii) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與線段 \(AB\) 的幾何關係。
(b) 若 \(AB\) 為圓 \(x^2+y^2-2ax+4ay-85=0\) 的弦，其中 \(a\) 為常數，求 \(a\) 的值。
questions.hint: AG=BG means G is equidistant from A and B — write the distance formula, square both sides, and simplify. For (b), remember the perpendicular bisector of a chord always passes through the circle centre.
questions.hintZh: AG=BG 即 G 到 A、B 等距——寫距離公式，兩邊平方化簡。(b) 記住弦的垂直平分線必過圓心。
questions.solution:
10. (a)(i) Let \((x, y)\) be the coordinates of \(G\).

\[
\begin{aligned}
& \because \quad A G=B G \\
& \quad \begin{aligned}
\sqrt{[x-(-4)]^{2}+(y-3)^{2}} & =\sqrt{(x-6)^{2}+(y-5)^{2}} \\
\therefore \quad x^{2}+8 x+16+y^{2}-6 y+9 & =x^{2}-12 x+36+y^{2}-10 y+25 \\
20 x+4 y-36 & =0 \\
5 x+y-9 & =0
\end{aligned}
\end{aligned}
\]

Thus, the equation of \(\Gamma\) is \(5 x+y-9=0\).
(ii) \(\Gamma\) is the perpendicular bisector of the line segment \(A B\).
(b) Note that perpendicular bisector \(\Gamma\) of chord \(A B\) passes through the centre of the circle.

The coordinates of the centre of the circle are \((a,-2 a)\).

By (a), we have \(5 a-2 a-9=0\).

So, we have \(a=3\).
questions.solutionZh:
10. (a)(i) 設 \(G=(x,y)\) 為所求動點。

\[
\begin{aligned}
& \because \quad AG=BG \\
& \sqrt{[x-(-4)]^{2}+(y-3)^{2}}=\sqrt{(x-6)^{2}+(y-5)^{2}} \\
& \therefore \quad x^{2}+8x+16+y^{2}-6y+9=x^{2}-12x+36+y^{2}-10y+25 \\
& 20x+4y-36=0 \\
& 5x+y-9=0
\end{aligned}
\]

所以 Γ 的方程為 \(5x+y−9=0\)。

(a)(ii) Γ 是線段 AB 的垂直平分線。

(b) 弦 AB 的垂直平分線必經過圓心。

圓心坐標為 (a,−2a)。

由 (a) 得 \(5a−2a−9=0\)。

所以 \(a=3\)。
